validity.researcher_notes: P4453 Oasis Gas Pipeline Modernization is a debottlenecking/modernization project (0 mi new pipe, 60 MMcf/d incremental capacity) on Energy Transfer's Oasis intrastate system in Texas. EIA long data shows the project transitioned from Construction (Oct 2022-Apr 2023 releases) to Completed status in Jul 2023 release with in-service date 2022-12-01. This is consistent with the sheet's ConstructionYear=2022 but conflicts with Status=construction (should be operating). The project is real, operates in Texas (confirmed on Energy Transfer intrastate ops page and EIA), and is correctly classified as an intrastate gas expansion. No duplicate issues detected. The status change is material and is flagged in the status_reviews section below.
